description: This source file implements webhook endpoints for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket within a FastAPI web application. It handles security verification, parses incoming JSON payloads, normalizes events into a common schema (GitEvent), and persists them into a database. The file defines route handlers, payload processing functions, and utility functions for verifying signatures, extracting repository info, and handling idempotency.
